name: Adjourned Agenda and Minutes
agenda_text:
AGENDA FOR THE
SAN DIEGO CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA FOR REGULAR COUNCIL MEETINGS
OF
MONDAY, MAY 25, 2026
TUESDAY, MAY 26, 2026
MONDAY, JUNE 01, 2026
TUESDAY, JUNE 02, 2026
CITY ADMINISTRATION BUILDING
COUNCIL CHAMBERS – 12 TH FLOOR
202 “C” STREET
SAN DIEGO, CA 92101
---------------------------
The City Council meetings of May 25 through June 2 of 2026 have been adjourned, pursuant to the 2026 Legislative Calendar adopted by Resolution 316464 on October 21, 2025.
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the City Council is Monday, June 8, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., and Tuesday, June 9, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.
